lines.text: The governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and put a purple robe and a crown of thorns on Him.
The soldiers spit on Jesus and struck Him on the head, then forced Simon from Cyrene to carry His cross.
At a place called Golgotha, they offered Jesus wine mixed with gall, but after tasting it He refused to drink.
The soldiers cast lots for His garments and posted a charge above Him calling Him King of Israel.
Passersby told Jesus to come down, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders said they would believe if He did.
